name: chessnova
description: ChessNova — A modern digital chess universe

scripts.build: npm --prefix client run build && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npx prisma generate --schema=./prisma/schema.prisma && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix client run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix server install
